verses.text: From ancient times, the Lord God spoke to our fathers through the prophets in many kinds and in many ways.
But in these last days, He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, through whom also He made the worlds.

He, being the radiance of His glory and the exact representation of His nature, and upholding all things by the word of His power, when He had made purification for our sins, sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
To such an extent, He has inherited a name more excellent than theirs, as He has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
For to which of the angels did He ever say, “You are My Son, today I have begotten You”? And again, “I will be to Him a Father, and He shall be to Me a Son”?
And again, when He brings the firstborn into the world, He says, “Let all the angels of God worship Him.”
And of the angels He says, “Who makes His angels spirits and His ministers a flame of fire.”
But to the Son He says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; a scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.”
“You have loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness more than Your companions.”
He also says, “You, Lord, in the beginning laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.”
እነርሱ ያልፋሉ፤ አንተ ግን ትኖራለህ፤ ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ያረጃል፤
እንደ መጋረጃም ትጠቀልላቸዋለህ፤ ይለወጣሉም፤ አንተ ግን መቼም መች አንተ ነህ፤ ዘመንህም የማይፈጸም ነው።”
ከሆነ ጀምሮ ከመላእክት፥ “ጠላቶችህን ከእግርህ ጫማ በታች እስከ አደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ” ማንን አለው?
መላእክት ሁሉ መናፍስት አይደሉምን? የዘለዓለም ሕይወትን ይወርሱ ዘንድ ስለ አላቸው ሰዎችስ ለአገልግሎት ይላኩ የለምን?

sections.title: Concerning the world that is to come.

verses.text: ስለዚህም ከሰማነው ነገር ምንአልባት እንዳንወሰድ ለእርሱ አብዝተን ልንጠነቀቅ ይገባናል።
በመላእክት የተነገረው ቃል ጽኑ ከሆነ፥ መተላለፍና አለመታዘዝም ሁሉ የጽድቅን ብድራት ከተቀበለ፥
እኛስ እንዲህ ያለውን ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብንለው እንዴት እናመልጣለን? ይህ በጌታ በመጀመሪያ የተነገረ ነበረና የሰሙትም ለእኛ አጸኑት።
እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ራሱ ፈቃድ የመንፈስ ቅዱስን ጸጋ በመስጠት፥ በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር፥ በልዩ ልዩ ተአምራትም መሰከረላቸው፤ ነገራቸውንም አስረዳላቸው።
ስለ እርሱ የምንናገርለትን የሚመጣውን ዓለም ለመላእክት ያስገዛ አይደለም።
ነገር ግን መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ብሎ የመሰከረበት ስፍራ አለ፤ “ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድን ነው? ትጐበኘውስ ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድን ነው?
ከመላእክትህ ጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ የክብርና የምስጋና ዘውድንም ጫንህለት፤ በእጆችህም ሥራ ሁሉ ላይ ሾምኸው።
ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አድርገህ አስገዛህለት።” ሁሉን ለእርሱ ባስገዛለት ጊዜም የተወውና ያላስገዛለት የለም፤ አሁን ግን ሁሉን እንዳስገዛለት አናይም።
ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስለ ሰው ሁሉ ሞትን ይቀምስ ዘንድ ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አንሶ የነበረውን ኢየሱስን ከሞት መከራ የተነሣ የክብርና የምስጋናን ዘውድ ጭኖ እናየዋለን።
ብዙ ልጆችን ወደ ክብር ሲያመጣ የመዳናቸውን ራስ በመከራ ይፈጽም ዘንድ ከእርሱ የተነሣ ሁሉ በእጁ ለተያዘ፥ በእርሱም ሁሉ ለሆነ ለእርሱ ተገብቶታልና።
He is the one who sanctified them, and they who are sanctified are all one with Him; therefore, He does not shy away from calling them "brethren."
"I will declare Thy name unto my brethren; in the midst of the congregation will I praise Thee," He said.
And again, He said, "Behold, I and the children which God hath given me." And again, He said, "I will put my trust in Him."
For as children are partakers of flesh and blood, He also Himself likewise took part of the same; that through death He might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil.
All their lifetime they were subject to bondage through fear of death; and He will deliver all who were held captive by the fear of death.
For He took not on Him the nature of angels, but He took on Him the seed of Abraham.

Wherefore, in all things it behoved Him to be made like unto His brethren, that He might be a merciful and faithful High Priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
For in that He Himself hath suffered being tempted, He is able to succor them that are tempted.

sections.title: Concerning the house and its owner.

verses.text: አሁንም ከሰማያዊ ጥሪ ተካፋዮች የሆናችሁ ቅዱሳን ወንድሞቻችን ሆይ፥ የሃይማኖታችንን ሐዋርያና ሊቀ ካህናት ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ተመልከቱ።
ሙሴ ደግሞ በቤቱ ሁሉ የታመነ እንደ ሆነ፥ እርሱ ለላከው የታመነ እውነተኛ ነው።
ነገር ግን የባለቤት ክብሩ ከቤቱ እንደሚበልጥ፥ ክብሩ ከሙሴ ክብር ይልቅ እጅግ ይበልጣል፤
ቤትን ሁሉ ሰው ይሠራዋልና፤ ለሁሉ ግን ሠሪው እግዚአብሔር ነው።
ሙሴስ በኋላ ስለሚነገረው ነገር ምስክር ሊሆን በቤቱ ሁሉ እንደ ሎሌ የታመነ ነበረ።
ክርስቶስ ግን እንደ ልጅ በቤቱ ላይ የታመነ ነው፤ እኛም የምንደፍርበትን፥ የምንመካበትንም ተስፋ እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ ቤቱ ነን።
መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንዲህ ብሎአልና፥ “ዛሬ ቃሉን ብትሰሙ ልባችሁን አታጽኑ።
በምድረ በዳ በተፈታተኑበት ቀን እንደ አሳዘኑት ጊዜ።
የተፈታተኑኝ አባቶቻችሁ ፈተኑኝ፤ አርባ ዘመንም ሥራዬን አዩ።
ስለዚህ ይህቺን ትውልድ ተቈጣኋት፤ እንዲህም አልሁ፦ ‘ልባቸው ዘወትር ይስታል፤ እነርሱ ግን መንገዴን አላወቁም።’
"And they shall not enter into my rest, saith I in my wrath."
"Brethren, take heed; lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, departing from the living God."
"Today, while it is said, 'If you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts,' let every man examine his own body, lest he fall into sin."
"Let us hold fast our profession, for we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast unto the end."
"Today, if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation."
"To whom did he swear that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?"
"Who were those that were punished for forty years? Were they not those who sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?"
"Who is it that speaks of not entering into his rest, except for those who disobeyed?"
"We do not believe, and behold, we see that we are unable to enter."

Therefore, do not be careless; and concerning the rest, you shall command us to enter into rest; for if there be any fault among you, as is customary, and if it be grievous, it shall not be said that it leads to rest.
For those also, as it has been said, we have been gathered together; yet the word they heard did not profit them, because it was not mixed with faith in those who heard it.
Since the world was created, even if it were to be accomplished, He has said, “Thus they shall not enter into My rest,” and we believe that we shall enter into rest.
Concerning the seventh day, it is said, “The Lord rested on the seventh day from all His work.”
Again, He has said, “They shall not enter into My rest.”
Therefore, some, because there was a way for them to enter, did not enter due to the hardness of their hearts.
“Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts,” as it was said before, this shall continue as “Today” in the days of David.
Even if He had delayed, it was not spoken of another day after many years.
For it is known that there remains a rest for the people of God.
For He who has entered into His rest has himself also ceased from his works, as God did from His. Behold, He has ceased from all His works.
Therefore, let us not fall as those who have fallen, but let us strive to enter into the rest.

For the word of the Lord is living and active; sharper than any two-edged sword, it pierces to the division of soul and spirit, of joints and marrow, and discerns the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
All things are naked and exposed to His eyes; nothing is hidden from Him, but all creation is revealed before Him.
Therefore, we have a great High Priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus Christ, the Son of God; let us hold fast our confession in Him.
Our High Priest is not unable to sympathize with our weaknesses; rather, He has been tempted in every way, yet without sin.
Thus, let us approach the throne of grace with confidence, that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
The high priest, chosen from among men, is appointed for the sake of sin and offerings, and he is to offer for the people, for all that pertains to man shall be presented before the Lord.
For he himself is weak, and being unacquainted with them, he is able to suffer along with those who are ignorant.
Therefore, it is fitting that he should offer sacrifices for the people, and likewise for himself, for his own sins.
As with Aaron, no one takes this honor upon himself, but he who is called by God, just as Aaron was.
Likewise, Christ did not glorify himself to become a high priest, but it was He who said, “You are my Son; today I have begotten you.”
Again, He says, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
And in the days of His flesh, when He had offered up prayers and supplications, with vehement cries and tears to Him who was able to save Him from death, and was heard because of His godly fear.
Though He was a Son, yet He learned obedience by the things which He suffered.
And having been perfected, He became the author of eternal salvation to all who obey Him.
And God has appointed Him as a high priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.
ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፤ ጆሮዎቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።
መምህራን ልትሆኑ ሲገባችሁ፥ ካመናችሁ ጀምሮ በትምህርት ላይ የቈያችሁ ስለ ሆነ፥ እስከ ዛሬም ገና የእግዚአብሔርን የቃሉን መጀመሪያ ትምህርት ሊያስተምሩአችሁ ትወዳላችሁ፤ ወተትንም ሊግቱአችሁ ትሻላችሁ፤ ጽኑ ምግብንም አይደለም።
ወተትን የሚጋት ሁሉ ሕፃን ስለሆነ፥ የጽድቅን ቃል ሊያውቅ አይሻም።
ጠንካራ ምግብ ግን መልካሙንና ክፉዉን ለመለየት በሥራቸው የለመደ ልቡና ላላቸው ለፍጹማን ሰዎች ነው።
ስለዚህም የክርስቶስን የነገሩን መጀመሪያ ትተን ወደ ፍጻሜው እንሂድ፤ እንግዲህ ደግሞ ሌላ መሠረት እንዳትሹ ዕወቁ፤ ይኸውም ከሞት ሥራ ለመመለስ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ለማመን፥
ጥምቀትን፥ በአንብሮተ እድ መሾምን፥ የሙታንን ትንሣኤና የዘለዓለም ፍርድን ለመማር ነው።
እግዚአብሔርም ቢፈቅድ ይህን ባደረግን ነበር።
ነገር ግን አንድ ጊዜ ብርሃን የበራላቸውን፥ ሰማያዊውንም ስጦታ የቀመሱትን፥ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ተካፋዮች ሆነው የነበሩትን፥
መልካሙን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል፥ የሚመጣውንም የዓለምን ኀይል የቀመሱትን፥
በኋላም የካዱትን እንደ ገና ለንስሓ እነርሱን ማደስ አይቻልም፤ ራሳቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ይሰቅሉታልና፥ ያዋርዱትማልና።
ምድርም በእርስዋ የሚወርደውን ዝናም ከጠጣች፥ ያንጊዜ ስለ እርሱ ያረሱላትን መላካም ቡቃያ ታበቅላለች፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድም በረከትን ታገኛለች።
እሾህንና ኵርንችትን ብታወጣ ግን የተጣለች ናት፤ ለመርገምም የቀረበች ናት፤ ፍጻሜዋም ለመቃጠል ይሆናል።
የተመረጣችሁ ወንድሞቻችን ሆይ፥ ምንም እንኳን እንዲህ ብንላችሁ ሕይወት ወዳለባት ትምህርት እንድትቀርቡ እንታመንባችኋለን።
እግዚአብሔር ቅዱሳንን ስለ አገለገላችሁ፥ እስከ አሁንም ስለምታገለግሉአቸው ያደረጋችትሁን ሥራ፥ በስሙም ያሳያችሁትን ፍቅር ይረሳ ዘንድ ዐመፀኛ አይደለምና።
Yet, all of you, in this hope, may you show your steadfastness until the end, for we are encouraged by this.
Let not the doubters be as those who have inherited hope through faith and patience, for they are like those who have been led astray.
እግዚአብሔርም ለአብርሃም ተስፋዉን በሰጠው ጊዜ ይምልበት ዘንድ ከእርሱ የሚበልጥ ሌላ ባይኖር፥ በራሱ ማለ።
እንዲህ ብሎ፦“ መባረክን እባርክሃለሁ፥ ማብዛትንም አበዛሃለሁ።”
ከዚህም በኋላ ታግሦ ተስፋዉን አገኘ።
ሰው ግን ከእርሱ በሚበልጠው ይምላል፤ የክርክርም መነሻው በመሐላ ይፈጸማል።
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር ተስፋውን ለሚወርሱ ሰዎች ምክሩን እንደማይለውጥ ሊገልጥ ወደደ፤ እንደማይለውጥም በመሓላ አጸናው።
የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሐሰት ሊሆን አይቻልም፤ በእርሱ ለተማፀን ተጠብቆልን ባለ ተስፋችንም ማመንን ላጸናን ለእኛ ታላቅ ደስታ አለን።
ይህችም ተስፋ ነፍሳችን እንዳትነዋወጥ እንደ መልሕቅ የምታጸና ናት፤
እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘለዓለም ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ ሐዋርያችን ኢየሱስ ከእኛ በፊት ወደ ገባባት መጋረጃም ውስጥ የምታስገባ ናት።
የሳሌም ንጉሥ፥ የልዑል እግዚአብሔርም ካህን የሆነ፥ ይህ መልከ ጼዴቅ፥ አብርሃም ነገሥታትን ድል ነሥቶ በተመለሰ ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገናኝቶ ባረከው።
አብርሃምም ከገንዘቡ ሁሉ ከዐሥር አንድ ሰጠው፤ መጀመሪያ የስሙ ትርጓሜ የጽድቅ ንጉሥ ነበር፤ በኋላም የሳሌም ንጉሥ ተባለ፤ የሰላም ንጉሥ ማለት ነው።
አባት የለውም፤ እናትም የለችውም፤ ትውልዱም አይታወቅም፤ ለዘመኑ መጀመሪያ፥ ለሕይወቱም መጨረሻ የለውም፤ ክህነቱ የወልደ እግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ ሆኖ ለዘለዓለም ይኖራል።
የአባቶች አለቃ አብርሃም ከምርኮው ሁሉ የሚሻለውን ዐሥራት የሰጠውን የዚህን ካህን ክብር ታያላችሁን?
ከሌዊ ልጆችም፥ ክህነትን የሚቀበሉት ከሕዝቡ ማለት ከወንድሞቻቸው፥ እነርሱ ምንም ከአብርሃም ወገብ ቢወጡ ከእነርሱ ዐሥራትን በሕግ እንዲያስወጡ ትእዛዝ አላቸው።
ወገናቸው ላይደለ ለእርሱ ግን አብርሃም ዐሥራትን ሰጠው፤ እርሱም ተስፋ ያለው አብርሃምን ባረከው።
ነገር ግን ታላቁ ታናሹን እንደሚባርከው ያለ ጥርጥር ይታወቃል።
በዚህስ የሚሞት ሰው ዐሥራትን ይቀበላል፤ በወዲያው ግን ሕያው እንደ ሆነ መጽሐፍ የሚመሰክርለት እርሱ ይቀበላል።
እንደ ተነገረም ዐሥራትን የሚቀበል ሌዊ ስንኳን በአብርሃም በኩል ዐሥራትን ሰጠ።
መልከ ጼዴቅ በተገናኘው ጊዜ ገና በአባቱ በአብርሃም ወገብ ነበርና።

Therefore, the people have received the law established by the Levitical priesthood; and if there be found perfection in that priesthood, why is there a need for another priest to arise, one who is not counted among the order of Aaron, but rather one who is of the order of Melchizedek?
Their priesthood is not without end; for if their priesthood were to pass away, their law would also pass away.
This matter has been spoken of, for He has been made a part of another lineage; and from that time forth, no one has ministered at the altar.
Our Lord has been made manifest as one who has come from the lineage of Judah; therefore, concerning this priesthood, Moses spoke nothing.
Indeed, this greatly clarifies; for it is said that another priest shall arise in the order of Melchizedek.
For this is not a law made for flesh and blood, but rather a power of life that does not pass away.
"You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek," it is said of Him.
Therefore, if you are grieved, and if you do not take heed, the commandment that was first given has been annulled.
The law has not been made void; however, in itself, it has become a better hope by which we draw near to God.
He is not without a priesthood; for there are priests who have been appointed without a priesthood.
በመሐላ የሾመውን ግን፥ “እግዚአብሔር ማለ፥ አይጸጸትምም፤ አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት የዘለዓለም ካህን ነህ” አለው።
ኢየሱስ ይህን ያህል በምትበልጥና ከፍ ባለች ሹመት ተሾመ።
ለእነዚያስ ብዙዎች ካህናት ነበሩአቸው፤ ሞት ይሽራቸው፥ እንዲኖሩም አያሰናበታቸውም ነበርና።
እርሱ ግን ለዘለዓለም ይኖራል፤ ክህነቱ አይሻርምና።
ዘወትር በእርሱ በኩል ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚቀርቡትን ሊያድናቸው ይቻለዋል፤ ለዘለዓለምም ሕያው ነውና ያስታርቃቸዋል።
ቅዱስና ያለ ተንኰል፥ ነውርም የሌለበት፥ ከኀጢአተኞችም የተለየ፥ ከሰማያትም ከፍ ከፍ ያለ፥ እንደዚህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት ይገባናል።
እርሱም እንደ እነዚያ ሊቃነ ካህናት አስቀድሞ ስለ ራሱ ኀጢአት በኋላም ስለ ሕዝቡ ኀጢአት ዕለት ዕለት መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ አያስፈልገውም፤ ራሱን ባቀረበ ጊዜ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ አድርጎአልና።
ኦሪትስ የሚሞት ሰውን ሊቀ ካህናት አድርጋ ትሾማለች፤ ከኦሪት በኋላ የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር የመሐላ ቃሉ ግን ዘለዓለም የማይለወጥ ፍጹም ወልድን ካህን አድርጎ ሾመልን።
ከተናገርነውም ዋናው ነገር ይህ ነው፤ በሰማያት በግርማው ዙፋን ቀኝ የተቀመጠ እንዲህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት አለን።
እርሱም የመቅደስና የእውነተኛይቱ ድንኳን አገልጋይ ነው፤ እርስዋም በሰው ሳይሆን በእግዚአብሔር የተተከለች ናት።
ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ መባንና መሥዋዕትን ያቀርብ ዘንድ ይሾማል፤ ለዚህም ደግሞ የሚያቀርበው አንዳች ነገር ይኖረው ዘንድ ይገባል።
በምድር ቢሆን ኖሮ፥ ሊቀ ካህናት ባልሆነም ነበር፤ በኦሪት ሕግ መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርቡ ካህናት በእርስዋ አሉና።
እነርሱም ሙሴ ድንኳኒቱን ሲሠራ ሳለ እንደ ተረዳ፥ ለሰማያዊ ነገር ምሳሌና ጥላ የሚሆነውን ያገለግላሉ፤ “በተራራው እንደ ተገለጠልህ ምሳሌ ሁሉን ታደርግ ዘንድ ተጠንቀቅ” ብሎት ነበርና።
ዛሬ ግን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የምትበልጠውን አገልግሎት ገንዘብ አደረገ፤ ለታላቂቱ ሥርዐትም መካከለኛ ሆነ፤ የምትበልጠውንም ተስፋ ሠራ።
ፊተኛይቱ ያለ ነቀፋ ብትሆን ኖሮ ሁለተኛይቱን ባልፈለገም ነበር።
ነገር ግን እነርሱን ነቅፎ እንዲህ አለ፥ “እነሆ፥ ለቤተ እስራኤልና ለቤተ ይሁዳም አዲስ ኪዳን የምሠራበት ዘመን ይመጣል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
እጃቸውን ይዤ ከምድረ ግብፅ ባወጣኋቸው ጊዜ ለአባቶቻቸው እንደ ገባሁት እንደዚያ ያለ ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልኖሩምና፤ እኔም ቸል ብያቸዋለሁና” ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
ከእነዚያ ዘመናት በኋላ ለቤተ እስራኤል የምገባው ቃል ይህ ነው፦ ሕጌን በልባቸው አሳድራለሁ፤ በሕሊናቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፤ አምላክ እሆናቸዋለሁ፤ እነርሱም ሕዝቤ ይሆኑኛል ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
Therefore, let not one man teach another; nor let a brother teach his brother, saying, "Know the Lord," for they shall all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.
I will remember their iniquity, and their sin I will not forget."
The new commandment, in saying this, is a witness to that which was established before; it is for destruction that which is old and decayed.

sections.title: Concerning the sanctuary that was before.

verses.text: ፊተኛይቱም ደግሞ የአገልግሎት ሥርዐትና የዚህ ዓለም የሆነው መቅደስ ነበራት።
የመጀመሪያዪቱም ድንኳን ተዘጋጅታ ነበርና፥ በእርስዋም ቅድስት በምትባለው ውስጥ መቅረዙና ጠረጴዛው፥ የመሥዋዕቱም ኅብስት ነበረባት።
ከሁለተኛው መጋረጃ በስተኋላ የነበረችውን የውስጠኛዪቱን ድንኳን ግን ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ይሉአት ነበር።
በውስጥዋም የወርቅ ማዕጠንትና ሁለንተናዋን በወርቅ የለበጡአት፥ የኪዳን ታቦት፥ መና ያለባት የወርቅ መሶብና የለመለመችው የአሮን በትር፥ የኪዳኑም ጽላት ነበሩባት።
በላይዋም ማስተስረያውን የሚጋርዱ የክብር ኪሩቤል ነበሩ፤ ነገር ግን በየመልኩ እናገረው ዘንድ ዛሬ ጊዜው አይደለም።
ሥርዐቱ፥ ዝግጅቱም እንዲህ ነበር፤ በመጀመሪያዪቱም ድንኳን በየጊዜው አገልግሎታቸውን ይፈጽሙ ዘንድ፥ ካህናት ዘወትር ይገቡ ነበር።
ወደ ሁለተኛዪቱ ክፍል ግን ሊቀ ካህናቱ ኀጢአታቸውን ለማስተስረይ ስለ ራሱና ስለ ሕዝቡ የሚያቀርበውን ደም ይዞ፥ በየዓመቱ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻውን ይገባ ነበር።
ፊተኛይቱም ድንኳን በዚህ ገና ቆማ ሳለች፥ ወደ ቅድስት የሚወስደው መንገድ ገና እንዳልተገለጠ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ያሳያል።
ነገር ግን ለሚያቀርበው ሰው ግዳጅ መፈጸም የማይቻለውን መባና መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡበት የነበረው ለዚህ ዘመን ምሳሌ ሆነ።
እነዚህም እስከ መታደስ ዘመን ድረስ የተደረጉ፥ ስለ ምግብና ስለ መጠጥም፥ ስለ ልዩ ልዩ ጥምቀትም የሚሆኑ የሥጋ ሥርዐቶች ብቻ ናቸው።
ክርስቶስ ግን ለምትመጣይቱ መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ የሰው እጅ ወደ አልሠራት፥ በዚህ ዓለም ወደ አልሆነችው፥ ከፊተኛዪቱ ወደምትበልጠውና ወደምትሻለው ድንኳን፥
የዘለዓለም መድኀኒትን ገንዘብ አድርጎ፥ በገዛ ደሙ አንድ ጊዜ ወደ መቅደስ ገባ እንጂ በላምና በፍየል ደም አይደለም።
የላምና የፍየል ደም፥ በረከሱትም ላይ የሚረጭ የጊደር አመድ፥ የሚያነጻና የረከሱትንም ሥጋቸውን የሚቀድሳቸው ከሆነ፥
ነውር የሌለው ሆኖ፥ በዘለዓለም መንፈስ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረበ የክርስቶስ ደም ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን እናመልከው ዘንድ ሕሊናችንን ከሞት ሥራ እንዴት ይልቅ ያነጻ ይሆን?
ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ሞትን ተቀብሎ፥ በቀደመው ሥርዐት ስተው የነበሩትን ያድናቸው ዘንድ ወደ ዘለዓለም ርስቱም የጠራቸው ተስፋውን ያገኙ ዘንድ፥ ለአዲሲቱ ኪዳን መካከለኛ ሆነ።
ኑዛዜ ያለ እንደሆነ የተናዛዡ ሰው ሞት ይመጣ ዘንድ ግድ ነው።
የሙአች ሰው ኑዛዜ የጸናች ናት፤ ተናዛዡ በሕይወት ባለበት ጊዜ አትጠቅምምና።
ስለዚህም ፊተኛው ኪዳን እንኳ ያለ ደም አልከበረም።
ሙሴ የኦሪትን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ለመላው ሕዝብ ከነገረ በኋላ፥ የላምና የፍየል ደም ከውኃ ጋር ቀላቅሎ፥ ቀይ የበግ ጠጕርና የስሚዛ ቅጠል ነክሮ መጽሐፈ ኦሪቱንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ይረጭ ነበር።
“እግዚአብሔር ያዘዛችሁ የኪዳኑ ደም ይህ ነው” ይላቸው ነበር።
The sanctuary and all the vessels of the altar were to be sprinkled with blood.

Moreover, it was to be done in this manner for all that was brought near; according to the law of the firstborn, all was to be cleansed with blood; without the shedding of blood, however, there was no remission.
In the heavenly sanctuary, this work was performed; if this blood brings about redemption, then this heavenly offering shall be exalted above all.

Christ, having entered into the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man, did not enter to offer Himself repeatedly; but now, before God, He appears for us, having entered into the heavenly realm.
As the high priest was to do, having taken the blood of the year, he would enter into the holy place; yet he did not offer himself continually, as was required.
If this were not so, the world would have perished long ago; but now, at the consummation of the age, He has been manifested once to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
It is appointed for man once to die, and after that comes judgment.
Likewise, Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and to those who eagerly await Him, He will appear a second time, apart from sin, for salvation.
The law, being unable to bring forth that which is good, is not a true representation of the matter; therefore, it cannot fulfill that which is offered in those sacrifices presented annually.
If this were not the case, the sacrifices would have ceased, for they would have been able to atone for the sins of the offerers, and thus they would have been cleansed at once.
But in those sacrifices, there was a remembrance of sin made each year.
For the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins.
Therefore, when He comes into the world, He says, "Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You have prepared for Me."
In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin, You had no pleasure.
Then I said, "Behold, I have come— in the volume of the book it is written of Me— to do Your will, O God."

In saying, "Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and offerings for sin You did not desire, nor had pleasure in them," which are offered according to the law, He then said, "Behold, I have come to do Your will."
After saying, "Behold, I have come to do Your will," He takes away the first that He may establish the second.
By that will, we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
And the high priest would stand continually ministering, offering the same sacrifices, which could never take away sins.
But He, having offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down at the right hand of God.
Henceforth, He shall keep them until they fall beneath His feet.
And for those who are sanctified, He offered one sacrifice that shall be forever.
The Holy Spirit is our witness.
"After those days, says the Lord, I will put My laws into their hearts, and in their minds, I will write them."
"And I will remember their sins and their lawless deeds no more," He said.
Thus, if sin is taken away, henceforth, there is no need for sacrifices for sin.

sections.title: Concerning the Gospel of the Priests

verses.text: Therefore, brethren, we have boldness to enter the Holy Place by the blood of Jesus Christ.
In the flesh, He has consecrated for us a way of life and righteousness.
We have a great High Priest over the house of God.
Therefore, let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for He who promised is faithful.
Let us consider one another in love and good works, not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together as is the manner of some.
But let us encourage one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins.
But a certain fearful expectation of judgment and fiery indignation which will devour the adversaries.
Anyone who has rejected Moses' law dies without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

How much more shall it be fitting for you, who have been sanctified by the blood of the covenant, to be punished, as it is written, for having trampled underfoot the Son of God, and for having regarded as unclean the blood of the covenant by which you were sanctified, and for having insulted the Spirit of grace?
"I will take care of you; I will also repay your debts," we know this well; and again, "The Lord will judge His people."
It is indeed a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
Remember the former days in which you were illuminated, and endured a great struggle with sufferings.
You were indeed made a spectacle, both by reproaches and tribulations; and you became companions of those who were so treated.
For you had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your goods, knowing that you have a better and an enduring possession for yourselves in heaven.
Do not cast away your confidence, which has great reward.
For you have need of endurance, so that after you have done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
"For yet a little while, and He who is coming will come and will not tarry."
Now the just shall live by faith; but if anyone draws back, My soul has no pleasure in him."
But we are those who believe that they shall save their souls, and we are not among those who are destined for destruction.
Faith is the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen.
In this, He was well-pleased with the offerings of the righteous.
The world was created by the word of God, and we understand that what is seen was made from things that are not visible through faith.
Abel brought a greater offering to God in faith than Cain; and through this, he was commended as righteous, for God bore witness to his gifts. And though he died, he still speaks.
Enoch was taken up so that he should not see death; and he was not found, because God had taken him; for before he was taken, he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
Without faith, it is impossible to please God; for he who comes to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.
Noah, being warned of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his household; by which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
By faith, Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
By faith, he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
The city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God, is the one that He has prepared for them that love Him.
ራስዋ ሳራም መካን ሳለች ባረጀችበት ወራት ዘር ታስገኝ ዘንድ በእምነት ኀይልን አገኘች፤ ተስፋ የሰጣት የታመነ እንደ ሆነ አምናለችና።
ስለዚህም ደግሞ በብዛታቸው እንደ ሰማይ ኮከብ፥ እንደማይቈጠርም በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ የነበሩት የሞተን ሰው እንኳ ከመሰለው ከአንዱ ተወለዱ።
እነዚህ ሁሉ አምነው ሞቱ፤ ተስፋቸውንም አላገኙም፤ ነገር ግን ከሩቅ አይተው እጅ ነሱኣት፤ በምድሪቱም ላይ እነርሱ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች እንደ ሆኑ ዐወቁ።
እንዲህ የሚሉ ግን ሀገራቸውን እንደሚሹ ያሳያሉ።
ከእርስዋ የወጡባትን ሀገር ቢሹ ኖሮስ፥ ወደ እርስዋ ሊመለሱ በተቻላቸው ነበር።
አሁን ግን፥ በሰማያት ያለችውን የምትበልጠውን ሀገር ተስፋ ያደርጉ እንደ ነበር ታወቀ፤ ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው ተብሎ ይጠራ ዘንድ በእነርሱ አያፍርም፤ ተስፋ ያደረጉአትን ሀገር አዘጋጅቶላቸዋልና።
አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔር በፈተነው ጊዜ ልጁን ይስሐቅን ይሠዋው ዘንድ በእምነት ወሰደው።
“በይስሐቅ ዘር ይጠራልሃል” ብሎ ተስፋ ያናገረለትን አንድ ልጁን አቀረበው።
እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን ለይቶ ሊያስነሣው እንደሚችል አምኖአልና፤ ስለዚህም ያው የተሰጠው መታሰቢያ ሆነለት።
ያገኙት ዘንድ ስለ አላቸው ነገር ይስሐቅ ያዕቆብንና ኤሳውን በእምነት ባረካቸው።
And Jacob, at the time of his death, blessed each of Joseph's sons individually in faith; and he leaned upon the top of his staff.
And Joseph, at the time of his death, thought concerning the children of Israel that they should depart from Egypt in faith; and he commanded them not to leave their bones behind.
When Moses was born, he was hidden for three months in his father's house by faith; for the child was seen to be good, and they did not fear the king's command.
And Moses, in a time of danger, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter by faith.
For he chose to suffer affliction with the people of God rather than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season.
The reproach of Christ is of greater wealth than all the treasures of Egypt, for he looked to the reward.
Not fearing the wrath of the king, he endured as seeing Him who is invisible.
He kept the Passover by faith, lest he who destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
By faith they passed through the Red Sea as by dry land; whereas the Egyptians, attempting to do so, were drowned.
After seven days, the walls of Jericho fell down by faith.
The song of the righteous shall not perish with the wicked; for she has received the humble in peace.
What shall I say? Concerning Gideon, concerning Barak, concerning Samson, concerning Jephthah, concerning David, concerning Samuel, and concerning the other prophets, my time is short.
They fought valiantly in faith; they overcame kings; they wrought righteousness; they obtained promises; they shut the mouths of lions.
They quenched the power of fire; they escaped the edge of the sword; from weakness they were made strong; they became valiant in battle; they turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
Women received their dead raised to life again; and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection.
Those who were stoned, those who were sawn in two, and those who were slain with the sword, they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented.
They were of whom the world was not worthy; they wandered in deserts and mountains, in dens and caves of the earth.
And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise.
God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
That they may not be made perfect without us, for the Lord has prepared for us that which is beyond measure.

sections.title: Concerning the following of the Lord.

verses.text: Therefore, let us also strive to cast off all burdens of sin, as these witnesses surround us like a cloud, and let us run with perseverance the race set before us.
Let us follow the author and perfecter of our faith, Jesus; He is the light, and before Him is joy, for He has been exalted at the right hand of God.
Do not let your souls be troubled, but rather let your hearts be steadfast, remembering that you may be strengthened until you have overcome the temptations of sinners.
For you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood in your struggle against sin; therefore, do not lose hope in the instruction that leads you to obtain your promise.
As children, do not despise the discipline of the Lord, nor faint when you are rebuked by Him.
For the Lord disciplines those whom He loves, and He chastises every son whom He receives; thus, heed this counsel that has been given to you.
You shall receive your discipline; for He loves you as His children; for who is the son whom the father does not discipline?
However, every son is partaker of discipline; if you are without discipline, then you are not sons, but rather illegitimate children.
If we honor our earthly fathers who discipline us, how much more should we be subject to the Father of spirits and live?
For they indeed disciplined us for a short time as seemed best to them; but He disciplines us for our good, that we may share in His holiness.
ቅጣት ሁሉ በጊዜው ያሳዝናል እንጂ ደስ አያሰኝም፤ በኋላ ግን ለተቀጡ ሰላምን ያፈራል፤ ጽድቅንም ያሰጣቸዋል።
ስለዚህም የላሉትን እጆች፥ የሰለሉትንም ጕልበቶች አቅኑ።
አንካሳነታችሁ እንዲድንና እንዳትሰነካከሉ ለእግሮቻችሁ የቀና መንገድን አድርጉ።
ከሁሉ ጋር ወደ ሰላም ሩጡ፤ ቅድስናችሁንም አትተዉ፤ ያለ እርሱ ግን እግዚአብሔርን የሚያየው የለም።
አስተውሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ጸጋ የሚያቃልል አይኑር፤ ሕማምን የምታመጣ፥ ብዙዎችንም የምታስታቸውና የምታረክሳቸው መራራ ሥር የምትገኝበትም አይኑር።
ለጥቂት መብል ብኵርናውን እንደ ሸጠ እንደ ዔሳው ሴሰኛና ርኩስ የሚሆን አይኑር።
ከዚያ በኋላ እንኳ በረከትን ሊወርስ በወደደ ጊዜ እንደ ተጣለ ታውቃላችሁና፤ በእንባም ተግቶ ምንም ቢፈልጋት ለንስሓ ስፍራ አላገኘምና።
ሊዳሰስ ወደሚችል ወደሚቃጠልም እሳት ወደ ጭጋግም፥ ወደ ጨለማም ወደ ዐውሎ ነፋስም፥
ወደ መለከት ድምፅም፥ ወደ ቃሎችም ነገር አልደረሳችሁምና፥ ያንም ነገር የሰሙት ሌላ ቃል እንዳይጨመርባቸው ለመኑ።
የተነጋገራቸውን ሊሰሙት አልተቻላቸውም ነበርና፥ “እንስሳም ያን ተራራ ቢቀርበው በድንጋይ ይወግሩት” ነበር።
And behold, it was thus glorious; even Moses said, "I am afraid, I tremble."
But you, O city of the living God, unto Zion's hill, in the heavens, unto the heavenly Jerusalem, rejoice, for the angels that dwell therein have come to you.
Their names are written in heaven and in the assembly of the firstborn; all who are redeemed and unto God, and unto the spirits of the perfect righteous.
But the blood of the new covenant speaks better things than that of Abel; it has come to you, speaking of grace.
Take heed not to say, "Let it be," for they who are in the mountain of Sinai have been warned; if we turn our faces from Him who comes from heaven, how shall we be?
At that time, the word shall not depart from the earth; "Even now, I shall once again bring forth the earth," He said; not only the earth shall be, but also the heavens altogether.
Once again, they are the fruits that remain; that which does not depart shall be, and that which departs shall be shown as it is.
Therefore, let us receive the unshakable kingdom with reverence and fear, and let us seek the grace by which we may serve God acceptably, rejoicing in Him.
Our God is indeed a consuming fire of truth.

sections.title: Concerning love and the reception of strangers.

verses.text: ከወንድሞቻችሁ ጋር በፍቅር ኑሩ።
እንግዳ መቀበልንም አትርሱ፤ በዚህ ምክንያት ሳያውቁ መላእክትን በእንግድነት ለመቀበል ያታደሉ አሉና።
ከእነርሱ ጋር አብራችኋቸው እንደ ታሰራችሁ ሆናችሁ እስረኞችን ዐስቡ፤ መከራ የጸናባቸውንም በሥጋችሁ ከእነሱ ጋር እንዳላችሁ ሆናችሁ ዐስቡ።
መጋባት በሁሉ ዘንድ ክቡር ነው፥ ለመኝታቸውም ርኵሰት የለውም፤ ሴሰኞችንና አመንዝሮችን ግን እግዚአብሔር ይፈርድባቸዋል።
ገንዘብ ሳትወዱ ኑሩ፤ ያላችሁም ይበቃችኋል፤ እርሱ “አልጥልህም፤ ቸልም አልልህም” ብሎአልና።
አሁንም አምነን፥ “እግዚአብሔር ይረዳኛል፥ አልፈራም፥ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?” እንበል።
የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የነገሩአችሁን መምህሮቻችሁን ዐስቡ፤ መልካም ጠባያቸውን አይታችሁ በእምነት ምሰሉአቸው።
ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትናንትናና ዛሬ እስከ ዘለዓለም የሚኖር እርሱ ነውና።
ሌላ ልዩ ትምህርት አታምጡ፤ ልባችሁ በመብል ያይደለ በጸጋ ቢጸና ይበልጣልና፤ በዚያ ይሄዱ የነበሩ እነዚያ አልተጠቀሙምና።
ድንኳኒቱን ሲያገለግሉ የነበሩ ካህናት ከእርሱ ሊበሉ የማይቻላቸው መሠዊያ አለን፤
ሊቀ ካህናቱ የሚሠዉትን እንስሳ ደም ስለ ኀጢአት ወደ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ያቀርብ ነበርና፤ ሥጋውንም ከሰፈር ውጭ ያቃጥሉት ነበር።
ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ ሕዝቡን በደሙ ይቀድሳቸው ዘንድ ከከተማ ውጭ ተሰቀለ።
አሁንም ተግዳሮቱን ተሸክመን፥ ወደ እርሱ ወደ ከተማው ውጭ እንውጣ።
በዚህ የሚኖር ከተማ ያለን አይደለም፤ የምትመጣውን እንሻለን እንጂ።
በውኑ እንግዲህ በስሙ እናምን ዘንድ የከንፈሮቻችን ፍሬ የሚሆን የምስጋና መሥዋዕትን በየጊዜው ለእግዚአብሔር ልናቀርብ አይገባንምን?
ነገር ግን ለድሆች መራራትን፥ ከእነርሱም ጋር መተባበርን አትርሱ፤ እንዲህ ያለው መሥዋዕት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋልና።
Command your teachers; they shall be given to you; for concerning you, as they shall give answer before God, let them do so with joy, for they shall be troubled for your souls.
This shall be fitting for you to pray concerning us; as you desire good for all and as you hope, we also believe.
Rather, I urge you to do this swiftly, that I may be able to return to you.
In the eternal covenant, may the blood of our Lord Jesus, who is a great Redeemer, raise Him from the dead.
The God of peace, through Jesus Christ, may He grant you joy in His presence, as you fulfill His will, and may He perfect all your good works; to Him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
Brethren, I urge you to receive the word of counsel; I write to you in but a few words.
Our brother Timothy has been sent from us to you; he will surely come quickly.
Greet all your teachers and all the saints; peace be to all who are in Italy.
May the grace of our Lord be with you all; Amen.
